system.description:
Use this skill when you receive damage from the target. You may make the target make a [Safe Move (forced)] of 1 Sq. This movement must bring the target closer to you.

(Hate Top): Increase the distance the target moves by +1 Sq.

A special skill that pulls the enemy closer to you while restraining them with your weapon when attacked. In the case of a bow, the enemy is guided by a warning shot.
